_about: Everything the digestion story shows of the real body: the digestive system as an organ system. The gut (mouth, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, duodenum, small intestine, the four parts of the colon and the appendix) and the glands that pour juices into it: the three pairs of salivary glands and their ducts, the liver, the gall bladder and the bile duct, the pancreas and its ducts. The oesophagus, the small intestine (the atlas files the whole coil as the jejunum) and every duct are curves in the atlas and come as centrelines with a radius at each point: the page builds the tubes, and the same lines are the routes the food and the juices are found along. Skeleton, trachea and larynx are context, shown as ghosts. Build: node tools/anatomy/zanatomy.js build human_anatomy/digestion/digestion.recipe.json, then pack it into the page with node tools/anatomy/zanatomy-pack.js human_anatomy/digestion/digestion.glb human_anatomy/digestion/digestion.html.
